title: [Immersive Vehicles] R.A.G.E - Best cars to drive!
description: A pack that will add different cars to your Minecraft
body:
![logo](https://i.postimg.cc/B63cKVVf/r-a-g-e-curseforge.png)
![achtung](https://i.postimg.cc/853rB02J/warning-message.png)

# Install Official Content Pack and Immersive Vehicles

![abt](https://i.postimg.cc/kG4SN3Nh/about.png)
This pack adds a large number of cars, discs, wheels. Each car can be disassembled and tuned. In this pack there are more than 20 vehicles in which you can change a lot of parts, each vehicle contains many colours, has working lights and interior lighting

![fuckyou](https://i.postimg.cc/TwkL3N8r/r-a-g-e-faq.png)
👨‍💻Why cars are small compared to *insert other pack name*

🕵️‍♂️My cars are made in 1:1 size to the world, unlike most packs which are made in Steve:1 size, but you can resize car in config. Just change "packVehicleScales" to 1.2 for all R.A.G.E categories

👨‍💻When 1.2X.X or other newer versions?

🕵️‍♂️Nothing depends on me, because R.A.G.E is just a pack for Immersive Vehicles,
